2135. Counting the Number of Words in a Sentence

65

Problem Statement
Read a sentence and count the number of words in it, using a character array and a loop that looks for spaces.

Description
Read a full line of text into a character array using fgets, since a sentence may contain multiple words separated by spaces. Use a loop to scan through the characters, using an if statement to detect a space that is immediately followed by a non-space character, marking the start of a new word. Count the first word directly, then add one for every new word detected, and print the final count.
input_spec: A single line containing a sentence with words separated by single spaces.
output_spec: Print the number of words in the sentence.
